name: movie_epstau_isi
label: Movie: the red-clump giant epsilon Tau's |V|^2(B) with the ISI pair at 900 nm, one baseline per night from 20 to 180 m
notes: A red-clump giant (K0 III, 2.59 mas from the HST/CHARA radius and the Gaia parallax, V 3.5) on the ISI trucks: nine nights at 20-180 m East-West at 900 nm walk the measurements from |V|^2 ~ 0.9 through the 84 m first null into the first sidelobe (log scale); the joint fit of the diameter and the linear limb-darkening coefficient converges night by night.

epsilon Tau sits at the PDM's 4e6 cps operating cap only marginally, so unlike the bright giants its S/N is set by its own photons; it is the Hyades red-clump calibrator a season of nights would tie to 1-2 %.
